text:
Anya K: FYI customer ACME (acct acme-prod) opened a P1 - after the canary rollout at 09:12 UTC they say long conversations are losing earlier instructions and responses are truncating mid-sentence. They say this worked before the deploy.
Mason: Can you paste an example convo and request_id?
Anya K: They provided a session id and a sample request_id: `req_0a3f9b2c`. Example payload (sanitized):
```curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant. Follow instructions exactly."},{"role":"user","content":"Here is a long email thread, summarize and extract action items... (~12k tokens)"}],"max_tokens":1024,"stream":false}'
```
Anya K: Customer shows that the assistant ignores the system instruction after ~6k tokens and starts giving generic answers, plus one response ended abruptly (cut mid-sentence). They included full conversation text and timestamps, files attached in the ticket.
Julian: Do we have any rate-limit or chunking changes in today's deploy? I saw kernel selector updates and a batching tweak in runtime.
Mason: I rolled canary 3 -> 4 at 09:05, that included KV cache fix and a new attention-kernel heuristic. Possible regression in KV eviction policy for long contexts.
SRE Oncall: Putting this on pager. @support-bot can you correlate `req_0a3f9b2c` to host + model backend?
support-bot: Correlation: req_0a3f9b2c -> host i-0c4e9, model redwood-large-v2@canary-4, route eu-west-1, tokens in payload: 11890, response tokens: 512 (incomplete). Latency 420ms per token, no 5xx.
Julian: That token count is huge. Did the new batching heuristics change prefix/KV eviction watermarks?
Mason: I pushed a fix for memory compaction but maybe the eviction policy default was tightened. I'll check the canary config.
Anya K: Customer also reported slight increase in token charges because some spans were re-requested (they saw duplicate context appended by client?). They included transcript showing repeated prompt fragments.
Mason: Repro steps I'm running locally: 1) send same large convo with system prompt pinned 2) inspect kernel selection logs and KV cache hits 3) compare canary-3 vs canary-4 behavior
Julian: Add heuristics: capture `kv_cache_hit_rate`, `evicted_prefix_count`, and `kernel_variant` per request. If eviction spikes when seq_len > 8k then likely culprit.
SRE Oncall: Also check if fallback to previous model variant (canary-3) still triggers on quality regression. We have rollout policy but maybe fallback disabled for this deploy.
Mason: Quick log snippet from host i-0c4e9 during request:
```
[09:12:08] INFO request=req_0a3f9b2c kernel=flash_attn_v2 seq_len=12000 kv_hits=124 kv_evicted=9100
[09:12:08] WARN request=req_0a3f9b2c kv_evicted_high=1 policy=compact_to_fit
[09:12:09] INFO request=req_0a3f9b2c kernel=safe_attn seq_len=600 tail_trim=1
[09:12:09] ERROR request=req_0a3f9b2c output_truncated=true reason=kv_mismatch
```
Anya K: Customer is asking for a rollback if this is confirmed. They are on a dedicated SLA and this is impacting production.
Julian: If logs show `kv_evicted_high` for long sessions we likely have a regression in eviction thresholds. Suggest immediate action: 1) enable canary-3 traffic for this customer (route pin) 2) revert the eviction heuristic change in canary-4 3) gather 10 full failing requests for offline repro and eval.
Mason: I can pin their route to canary-3 for this customer account now and create a short-term hotfix branch to revert the compaction tweak. Pinning now: done. Noticing fewer reproductions on canary-3 during quick tests.
SRE Oncall: Please collect traces and full request/response for 10 failing sessions, include `kernel_variant`, `kv_evicted`, `kv_cache_size` and full token counts. Also get a minimal repro (trim messages until failure persists).
Anya K: I'll follow up with the customer, request the 10 failing session IDs and give ETA for rollback. They're appreciative of the pin. :thumbsup:
Julian: Postmortem action items: add automated long-session regression tests, add a regression gate on eviction policy changes, and ensure fallback route pinning works at scale.
Mason: For immediate triage I'll run A/B on the eviction threshold and run model quality checks on long-thread prompts overnight.
SRE Oncall: Thanks team. Marking incident P1 and creating incident doc in /incidents. I'll update once we have the 10 traces.
Anya K: Uploaded the ticket attachments to the incident doc and emailed ACME rep with rollback confirmation. Closing loop after traces are in. :white_check_mark:
